title: German Chocolate Cake with Italian Espresso
description: Moist German chocolate cake with an Italian twist, served with a shot of espresso. Perfect for a sophisticated dessert.
instructions: Melt the chocolate in a double boiler.
Whisk together the flour, sugar, and cocoa powder.
Beat the eggs and butter until light and fluffy.
Combine the egg mixture with the melted chocolate and flour mixture.
Pour the batter into greased cake pans.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let the cakes cool in the pans for 5 minutes.
Remove the cakes from the pans and let them cool completely.
